file.description: Use the file path you already selected. Supports ${env:NAME} placeholders. Passing a directory is only for a quick direct-child Name listing; use vulcan-file-list for recursive discovery.

segments.description: Preferred structured line-range input. Each item uses a 1-based start line and a positive count. Omit this field to read from the file start using the host file-read budget. Do not pass this field together with lines_rule.

start.description: 1-based first line to read for this segment.

count.description: Number of lines to read starting from start.

lines_rule.description: Legacy fallback for clients that cannot send arrays. Use LF newline-separated start,count segments such as "5,10\n25,30". Omit this field when segments is provided.

numbered.description: Keep true when you will cite or edit by line number. Set false only when raw text lines without L<number>: prefixes are more useful; the metadata header and multi-segment separators still remain.
